releaseApproval.reviewer: User-authorized v2.0.9 transfer optimization release; persistent formats unchanged
evidence: Automatic transfer concurrency starts at up to four and samples actual admitted network work; server limits and download memory budgets remain enforced.
Bounded upload preparation overlaps network sends, persists recovery records before PUT and erases buffers on completion, failure and cancellation.
Settings expose effective concurrency ceilings and explicit download budget adjustment. Folder loading status is centered with subdued opacity.
Local frontend validation passed: 587 tests, typecheck, production build, seven protocol/format checks and six Chromium transfer/resume/lock/cancellation E2E tests.
Publication requires full local make test, successful main-branch CI for the exact tagged commit, and release archive checksum verification.

scope: XDrive v2.0.9 improves bounded transfer scheduling and settings, and centers folder-loading status. SQLite schema 9 and encrypted persistent formats are unchanged.

sqlite.migrationPolicy: forward only; after a schema-changing migration, restore the matching pre-migration database and binary before rollback

clientMutationProtocol.acceptance: exact match only; reject missing, older, and future versions before reading mutation bodies

evolutionPolicy: Unknown payload versions and unknown fields remain fail-closed.
The listed optional fields and their absent-value meanings are part of the current schema contract.
Adding or redefining a payload field requires a new payload schema version; it must not silently expand an older strict reader.
A change that makes a stale client unsafe for mutations increments the client mutation protocol version in Go and TypeScript.
Key derivation or AAD meaning changes use their own crypto version; they do not reuse a payload schema number.
SQLite schema migration, backup container format, encrypted object envelope, and browser payload schema are independent version dimensions.
